responses.description: The role lacks the required permission.

description: Appends one movement (never edited or deleted; correct with an ADJUST). `qty` > 0 with ≤ 3 decimals (the direction gives the sign). The reason fixes the direction: PURCHASE is IN, ISSUE_TO_PROJECT is OUT (needs `ref_type` + `ref_uid`, e.g. `projects.project` + `{{projects_uid}}`), RETURN and ADJUST either way; ADJUST needs a `note`. `ref_type`/`ref_uid` come together; `procurement.batch_line` is reserved for committed batches. `at` defaults to now and may not be in the future (5 min tolerance, ISO 8601 with offset). An OUT that would take the balance below zero → 409 `insufficient_stock`, unless it is an ADJUST (booked and audited as a negative-stock override, `negative_override: true`). A soft-deleted component may only move its remaining stock towards zero. 404 while `INVENTORY_STOCK` is off.

description: Creates the reversing batch (COMMITTED at once, `reverses` → the original, lines/charges mirrored with negative quantities/amounts). Where the original's PURCHASE/LANDED row is still the current price it is replaced by the row it had superseded (`restored`) or closed when there was none (`closed`); prices a later batch already replaced are left alone (`superseded_since`). Needs a `reason`; `effective_from` defaults to today, not in the future and not before the original's (400). 409 `batch_not_committed`, `batch_is_reversal`, `batch_already_reversed`, `stale_version`. The response is `{reversal, lines}` — the reversal's uid is `reversal.uid` (not captured, so `{{procurement_batches_uid}}` keeps pointing at the original).
